era: PS2 sci-fi JRPG trilogy and Japanese spin-offs
summary: Monolith Soft and Namco's science-fiction Xeno subseries, covering the PS2 trilogy, the Japan-only Xenosaga Freaks disc, the canonical Pied Piper mobile prequel and its 2026 G-MODE rerelease, and the Nintendo DS remake of Episodes I and II.

entries.title: Xenosaga Episode I: Der Wille zur Macht
entries.definitive_edition: North American PlayStation 2 release via PCSX2, plus DS remake as supplemental story route

emulation.emulator: PCSX2; melonDS for Xenosaga I & II
emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 for the original PS2 presentation; use DS emulation only for the alternate remake content.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Upscaled PS2 output; DS remake is lower-fidelity but story-relevant.

primary.version: North American PS2 release via PCSX2
primary.why: The main English PS2 release is the cleanest full-playthrough route, and PCSX2 provides the highest-fidelity capture path. The Japanese Reloaded rerelease adds bonuses, while the DS remake retells Episode I/II with extra cut-story material, so those are noted as secondary/alternate routes rather than replacing the original Episode I.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped North American PS2 disc image in PCSX2 with high internal resolution and deinterlacing. Use Xenosaga I & II on DS afterward only if you want its alternate retelling and extra story material.

secondary.exclusive_content: Xenosaga I & II retells Episodes I and II with redrawn art, portable-adjusted gameplay, and additional story elements based on cut content from the console versions.
secondary.what_to_play: Play the DS remake as a supplementary alternate retelling after the PS2 original route.
secondary.why: The DS version adds story material, but it is Japan-only and not the highest-fidelity way to experience Episode I.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PS2 release; PCSX2 enables high internal resolution and capture flexibility.
all_releases.reason: primary: best English full-playthrough route with highest emulated fidelity.

all_releases.fidelity: Japan-only international rerelease with English voice work and additional costumes/bonus features.
all_releases.reason: skip: extra bonuses are documented, but it is not the cleanest English full-playthrough route and does not require a separate story-content playthrough.

all_releases.fidelity: Japan-only 2D DS remake/retelling of Episodes I and II.
all_releases.reason: secondary: play for additional story elements based on cut content, not as the highest-fidelity main Episode I route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PCSX2 gives the best-looking Episode I route, but the DS remake has additional story material; treat DS as a supplemental retelling.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official HD remaster of the PS2 trilogy is documented.

entries.title: Xenosaga: Pied Piper

emulation.emulator: Not needed for Steam; mobile preservation routes are historical only
emulation.notes: Prefer the official Steam rerelease for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Modern PC capture of the G-MODE Archives+ release.

primary.why: Pied Piper was originally a Japan-only feature-phone prequel, but the 2026 G-MODE Archives+ Steam release is the most accessible and highest-fidelity official preservation route. It remains Japanese-language only.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam G-MODE Archives+ release on Windows. Use the Switch version only if you specifically prefer that device; expect Japanese text.

all_releases.reason: skip: historically original but inaccessible and superseded for preservation by the 2026 G-MODE release.

entries.title: Xenosaga I & II

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Clean DS output with flexible screen arrangement.

primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped DS cartridge image in melonDS, configure a readable two-screen stream layout, and expect Japanese text unless using a separately sourced translation patch.
